replacement.before: All repeated-model tables use sample SD (ddof=1), matched seed sets and one terminal checkpoint for all metrics. Cross-scenario summaries first average within model seed.
replacement.after: The new repeated-model tables use one terminal checkpoint for all metrics and report sample SD (ddof=1) where repeated seeds are available. Matched seed sets are used for the new paired comparisons, and their cross-scenario summaries first average within model seed. The round-70 correction candidate likewise uses a common terminal checkpoint for all metrics. Historical Table II reconstructions retain their explicitly stated selection rules and actual repeat counts.
